project_overview.title: aikarau.com Homepage Public Conversion Landing Page
project_overview.summary: Transformation of the aikarau.com homepage from a static app selector into a high-converting, public landing page focused on webinar registrations while keeping the three-portal suite (AI KARAU, ENZI, MedMatch AI) accessible as a secondary entry section.
project_overview.primary_goal: Convert visitors into webinar signups via primary Hero CTA and dedicated Upcoming Webinars list linking directly to /karau-meet/webinar/{id}/register.
project_overview.secondary_goal: Provide friction-free navigation and launch points for the three core platform portals (AI KARAU, ENZI Messenger, MedMatch AI).

typography.accent_font: JetBrains Mono (for timestamps, live caption badges, 60+ language counts, and stats)
rules: Headings MUST NOT use plain default Inter font - use Manrope / Outfit for expressive brand voice.
Hero heading max size: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl with tight letter-spacing (tracking-tight). Do not exceed text-6xl.
NO pure un-tinted black (#000000). Always use rich obsidian slate #0B0F19.
Header and modals MUST NOT have transparent backgrounds without blur - use backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-800.
Ensure high contrast APCA standards (minimum 4.5:1 for body text against dark backgrounds).

layout_and_grids.spacing_scale: Generous spacing philosophy: section padding py-16 lg:py-24, grid gap gap-6 lg:gap-8.

elements: Logo (aikarau.com suite icon + brand name)
Nav links: Upcoming Webinars, Key Features, App Suite Portals, Downloads
Global Language Selector dropdown
CTAs: 'Open Suite App' and 'Sign In'
Main Conversion Tagline & Animated Live Webinar Badge
Primary Webinar Registration CTA button leading to /karau-meet/webinar/{id}/register
Interactive Spotlight Webinar Card showing upcoming/live topic, date/time, presenter avatar, live attendee count, and 1-click register form
Key value callouts: Live captions in 60 languages, LiveKit SFU low latency, AI Summaries & Transcripts
Section Header: 'Upcoming & Live AI Webinars'
Webinar Cards with Live/Scheduled status, host details, countdown timer/timestamp, attendee count, and direct 'Register' button (data-testid='webinar-register-btn-{id}')
API Integration: fetch from GET /api/webinars/public/upcoming with automatic live status indicators
Live Captions in 60 Languages: Interactive language switcher preview displaying real-time transcribed sample text
AI Summaries & Action Items: Preview card with automated key takeaways & instant email export simulation
Searchable Meeting Transcripts: Interactive search bar filtering live transcript lines with timestamp jumps
ENZI @AI Assistant: Simulated channel chat snippet showing bot command highlights (@AI summarize meeting)
Section Title: 'Access AI KARAU Product Suite'
3 Portal Cards: AI KARAU (Webinars/Meetings), ENZI (AI Messenger), MedMatch AI (Career Toolkit)
Auto-bundled badges for AI KARAU & ENZI
Direct domain badges (connect.aikarau.com, enzi.aikarau.com, medmatch.aikarau.com)
CTAs: 'Open AI KARAU', 'Open ENZI', 'Open MedMatch AI'
Desktop & Mobile clients download links (macOS, Windows, iOS, Android)
Direct link to /downloads page
Brand logo & suite description

Direct portal routes
Copyright & status indicator

motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Card elevation (-translate-y-2), subtle border glow, button sheen sweep.
motion_and_interactions.live_indicators: Pulsing red ring on live webinar status badge (animate-ping / animate-pulse).
motion_and_interactions.interactive_demos: Real-time tab toggle for 60-language live caption sample and transcript search input filter.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Specific property transitions only (e.g. transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease). Avoid universal transition: all.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: APCA AA standard for text contrast.
accessibility_and_testing.aria_labels: All interactive buttons and modals must have clear aria-label or visible text.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update `/app/frontend/src/pages/PortalSelector.jsx` to serve as the full public conversion landing page.

2. Ensure the top section is a Hero Spotlight highlighting webinar signup with a prominent CTA button that opens the registration flow at `/karau-meet/webinar/{id}/register` or opens a quick modal with the registration form.
3. Fetch upcoming webinars from `/api/webinars/public/upcoming` or render dynamic fallback sample webinars if the API response is loading or empty, each with a 'Register Now' button.
4. Add a Feature Highlights Bento Grid demonstrating live captions in 60 languages (interactive demo), AI summaries, searchable transcripts, and ENZI messenger features.
5. Maintain the 3 app entry cards (AI KARAU, ENZI, MedMatch AI) as a clear, secondary suite portal section further down the page.
6. Include Header actions (Sign in, Open App, Global Language Selector) and a Footer with legal links (/legal/privacy, /legal/terms).
7. Include all required `data-testid` attributes specified in the accessibility and testing section.
